geotag.description: Place from GPX tracks for photos whose request and EXIF have none: capture time -> UTC (camera_utc_offset), minus the camera clock offset, interpolated along the track (the rules of `bioscan geotag`). The place feeds identify's location prior.

camera_utc_offset.description: zone of capture times without an offset: -07:00, UTC, America/Los_Angeles; empty = the service's zone

offset.description: camera clock minus true time: +00:01:23 or seconds; empty = 0

output.dt_s: seconds to the nearest track point (gpx, none)

quality.description: Frame and subject technical quality and reject reasons. The subject is identify's best box: its sharpness and exposure (rules.quality, as in identify's boxes), blur (re-blur measure on its core), clipped highlight and shadow shares, area share of the frame, whether it touches the frame edge (cut off) and its placement (thirds / centre). Reasons: soft_subject, motion_or_defocus, overexposed, underexposed, subject_cut, subject_too_small, no_subject.

frame.blur: blur of the sharpest detailed tile outside the subject | null

subject.blur: float 0 sharp - 1 soft (re-blur measure) | null: too little detail to tell
subject.cut: bool: touches an edge and is not frame-filling
subject._: null when identify found no box
